```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
```

## read_acs

```{r}
read_acs <- function(ddi, path) {
  acs <- ipumsr::read_ipums_micro(ddi, data_file = path, verbose = FALSE)
  names(acs) <- tolower(names(acs))
  acs <- acs |> mutate(across(everything(), haven::zap_labels))

  need <- c("year", "age", "perwt", "sex", "bpl", "educ", "empstat", "gq",
            "ind1990", "incwage", "wkswork2", "uhrswork", "school",
            "classwkr", "classwkrd", "cpi99")
  stopifnot(all(need %in% names(acs)))

  acs |> filter(age >= 20, age <= 64, year >= 2005, year <= 2014)
}
```

## flag_nativity_education

```{r}
flag_nativity_education <- function(acs) {
  acs |>
    mutate(
      usb  = bpl <= 120,
      fb   = bpl > 120,
      ls   = educ <= 6,
      lefb = fb & ls,
      male = sex == 1
    )
}
```

## flag_employment

```{r}
flag_employment <- function(acs) {
  acs |>
    mutate(
      emp = empstat == 1 & gq %in% c(1, 2),
      emp = emp & !(ind1990 >= 900 & ind1990 <= 940)
    )
}
```

## restrict_wage_sample

```{r}
restrict_wage_sample <- function(acs) {
  bad_inc <- with(acs,
    (wkswork2 == 0) | (uhrswork == 0) | is.na(uhrswork) | (school == 2) |
    (classwkr == 1) | (classwkrd == 29) | (incwage %in% c(0, 999998, 999999)))
  bad_inc[is.na(bad_inc)] <- FALSE

  acs |> mutate(incwage = if_else(bad_inc, NA_real_, as.numeric(incwage)))
}
```

## convert_weeks

```{r}
convert_weeks <- function(acs) {
  acs |>
    mutate(weeks = c(8.0, 20.8, 33.1, 42.4, 48.3, 51.9)[match(wkswork2, 1:6)])
}
```

## deflate_income

```{r}
deflate_income <- function(acs) {
  cpi99_2014 <- mean(acs$cpi99[acs$year == 2014])
  stopifnot(is.finite(cpi99_2014))

  acs |> mutate(real_inc = incwage * cpi99 / cpi99_2014)
}
```

## hourly_wage

```{r}
hourly_wage <- function(acs) {
  acs |> mutate(wage_raw = real_inc / (weeks * uhrswork))
}
```

## winsorize_wage

```{r}
winsorize_wage <- function(acs) {
  q <- quantile(acs$wage_raw, c(0.025, 0.975),
                na.rm = TRUE, type = 2, names = FALSE)

  acs |> mutate(wage = pmin(pmax(wage_raw, q[1]), q[2]))
}
```

## flag_fulltime_wage

```{r}
flag_fulltime_wage <- function(acs) {
  acs |> mutate(wage_ft = if_else(emp & uhrswork >= 30, wage, NA_real_))
}
```

## check_means

```{r}
check_means <- function(acs) {
  wmean <- function(d) weighted.mean(d$wage_ft, d$perwt, na.rm = TRUE)

  chk <- tibble(
    group = c("LEFB", "US-born"),
    mean  = c(wmean(filter(acs, lefb, !is.na(wage_ft))),
              wmean(filter(acs, usb,  !is.na(wage_ft)))),
    paper = c(15.60, 24.39),
    n     = c(sum(acs$lefb & !is.na(acs$wage_ft), na.rm = TRUE),
              sum(acs$usb  & !is.na(acs$wage_ft), na.rm = TRUE))
  ) |> mutate(diff = mean - paper)

  if (any(abs(chk$diff) > 1)) {
    warning("wage_ft means are more than $1 from Table A1; recheck the rules.")
  }
  chk
}
```

## save_clean

```{r}
save_clean <- function(acs, path) {
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(acs, path)
  invisible(acs)
}
```

```{r}
acs_path <- "C:/Users/Kuthn/Downloads/usa_00002.dat/usa_00001.dat.dat"
```
